exposure: GDM diagnosis before 24 weeks of gestation
GDM diagnosis after 24 weeks of gestation
cohort: Singleton pregnancies complicated by GDM at the Pasig City General Hospital from January 2018 to December 2019.
finding: High-risk women diagnosed with GDM before 24 weeks of gestation had a higher incidence of preeclampsia compared with high-risk women diagnosed with GDM after 24 weeks of gestation.
